question: Compare the warranty requirements of both bids.
answer:
Bid1: The warranty period for staff laptops is a minimum of 3 years. Warranties shall be equal to or exceed those offered to the general public. Repairs or replacements will be performed by the awarded vendors at no cost within five business days.
Bid2: The warranty period is 3 years following the date of delivery.
warranty period: cited statements differ between Bid1, Bid2.
warranty service: stated only for Bid1; no validated statement for Bid2.
